name: TC-16-import-export
description: TC-16: Import & Export — Navigate to import/export pages and verify export/import template features

doc_metadata.title: TC-16.1 — Asset List (Export)
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to the Asset list. The Export function allows downloading entity data as Excel files with applied filters.

doc_metadata.title: TC-16.1 — Export Feature
doc_metadata.caption: The entity list toolbar includes an Export button. Apply filters (e.g., Site, Status) before exporting to get a filtered dataset. The export downloads as an Excel (.xlsx) file.

doc_metadata.title: TC-16.2 — Import/Export Page
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to the Import/Export page. This page provides bulk data import with template download, validation, and execution.

doc_metadata.title: TC-16.2 — Import Template Download
doc_metadata.caption: The import page allows selecting an entity type and downloading a template with correct headers. Upload a filled template to validate and import records in bulk.

doc_metadata.title: TC-16 — System Settings
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Settings to configure import/export options, data validation rules, and default field mappings.

doc_metadata.title: TC-16 — Settings Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The Settings page provides system configuration including import/export preferences, naming series, and workflow configuration.
